findings.text: the sentence says the after arm's measured revision 'is identical to the head the arm was declared at, 10d854ba1f, because the commits between them touch only this record', but the log it cites names 47796628bb and the two trees are not identical (606f89b1 against b23dff6d), because 2221249863 added a Python census script between them; a reader checking the sentence against its own evidence finds a contradiction.

this script and its .json sibling lie outside the node's two declared write paths, which name only the fragment .html and the figures topic directory; the coordinator's repair advice directed the commit under the evidence path, so the resolution is a one-line accept-path ratification rather than a repair.

the claim that a second census run over a fresh window 'named 313 ids and again reported no vanished run' has no artefact: logs/ holds only the first run's census.json and census.json.summary, so the 313 figure is a recalled delta rather than a recorded one.
